description: Template completeness advice for the documented SSP and DSP cookie-matching routes. Partner and user IDs stay opaque. Redirect configuration, callback ownership, duplicate selection, cookie state and receiver acceptance remain external. Complete HTTP captures retain the engine's existing URL-query and form-body merge; this profile does not prove query-only carriage or form transport support.

params.name: partner_id
params.description: The official SSP and DSP templates place the provisioned partner ID in this physical path slot. Nonempty presence is template advice. No numeric, UUID, length, allocation or decoded-ID grammar is documented.

params.name: remote_uid
params.description: Both official matching templates substitute the partner's user ID in remote_uid. Nonempty presence is template advice. Values and extras remain opaque. Ordinary engine extraction also accepts a form-body carrier in a complete capture; no query-only or receiver acceptance claim is made.
